statement: For every subgroup H of Homeo(R), including orientation reversals, each based loop in C_Homeo+(R)(H) contracts by the order-natural prefix-envelope median formula; in particular its based fundamental group is zero.
depends_on: Elementary compact-open topology of line homeomorphisms; compact extrema and order properties, all proved in the text
manuscript_passages: 23; folios 140–141; scans 279–281; Part C(b) infinite-operator request; exact partial reduction for C.12
depends_on_doubtful_reading: None: this auxiliary line statement has a separate explicit domain.
notes: The proof checks strict increase, uniform properness, continuity, based endpoints and exact commutation for both orientation signs. Applying the formula independently to surface orbit strata does not prove continuity across strata, and the general C.12 assertion is not deduced.
